component.name: kTomato
component.summary: Pomodoro timer with configurable presets and session statistics

description.p: kTomato is a Pomodoro timer for KDE Plasma 6. It provides configurable work and break phases, timer presets, session history, and productivity statistics.
kTomato is an independent project and is not an official KDE application.

ul.li: Work, short-break, and long-break phases with configurable durations and cycle count
User-defined presets with categories, symbolic icons, notification controls, and automatic-start modes
Configurable phase-end sounds, one-minute pre-alarm, and optional ambient focus audio
Optional screen-sleep inhibition during work phases
Session history, daily targets, streak tracking, charts, and CSV export
SQLite backup, restore, and session-history management
System tray integration and a D-Bus control interface
Optional calendar events for finished work sessions (Nextcloud login or any CalDAV calendar)
KRunner integration, optional automatic pause when the screen is locked, and task notes for completed sessions
Available in English, Italian, German, Spanish and French

description.p: Adds optional calendar events for finished work sessions.

ul.li: Calendar sync: add an event to your Nextcloud or CalDAV calendar each time a work session is completed (off by default)
Log in with Nextcloud through your browser, with no password to copy
Separate settings for Nextcloud and custom CalDAV, a calendar picker with a refresh button, a connection test and an optional task note in the event description
Events that cannot be sent are retried while kTomato is running
Passwords and addresses with credentials are removed from the diagnostics report
Work, short-break and long-break phases with configurable durations, cycle count and automatic-start modes
Timer presets with categories and symbolic icons; ready-made Pomodoro, Deep Work, Study and Quick Sprint timers
Breeze-style interface with a Breeze Dark default, a selectable color scheme and keyboard shortcuts
Animated Welcome tour and translations in English, Italian, German, Spanish and French
Statistics by day, week, month and year, daily goal, streaks, per-timer and per-category breakdowns, and CSV export
Task notes for completed work sessions, from the notification or an in-app prompt
Notification silencing and screen-sleep inhibition during work phases, with optional automatic pause when the screen is locked
Phase-end sounds, a one-minute pre-alarm and optional ambient focus audio
System tray with a live countdown icon, start at login and a D-Bus control interface
KRunner integration: control the timer, start a timer by name or an ad-hoc session such as "pomodoro 25"
Local SQLite storage with backup and restore, a manual update check and a diagnostics report
